basic_details.job_title: CMOH Purulia Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Lower Division Clerk Ayush, DEO and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Eight contractual posts under the National Ayush Mission for the District AYUSH Samity, Purulia are open to permanent residents of West Bengal: two Ayush Doctor posts (Rs. 40,000 a month), three Multipurpose Worker (MPW) posts (Rs. 15,000), one Data Entry Operator (Rs. 25,000), and one Lower Division Clerk (Rs. 10,000) and one Accountant (Rs. 12,000) for retired State Government employees. The Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health, Purulia (Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal) accepts applications online only on www.wbhealth.gov.in from 05.11.2026 (10:00 hr

how_to_apply: Go to www.wbhealth.gov.in and open Quick links → Career, Education & Recruitment → Online Recruitment.
Complete online registration by 18.11.2026; online applications are accepted from 05.11.2026 (10:00 hrs) to 19.11.2026.

Submit only one online application for a particular post. A candidate may apply for more than one post if eligible for each, but more than one application for the same post cancels all applications for that post.
Check every entry before final submission: no modification or correction is allowed after the application is finally submitted.
Do not send any physical documents to the office.
Appear in person for document verification with the online-generated application form signed by you, the originals and self-attested copies of the documents listed below.
Online-generated application form, duly signed, with one recent passport-size photograph pasted on it.
Madhyamik (or equivalent) Admit Card/Certificate as proof of age.
All relevant mark sheets and pass certificates; where DGPA/CGPA or Grade Point is awarded, the conversion formula.
Voter ID/Aadhaar Card/any other valid address proof.
All relevant experience certificates, with salary slips for the last three months against each claimed period of experience.
Valid EWS certificate issued by the competent authority, and caste certificate issued by the competent authority of the Government of West Bengal, wherever applicable.

LDC and Accountant: documents related to retirement [PPO] of State Govt. employees (as per Proforma enclosed – Annexure-A), experience certificate from the last employer, age proof, identity proof (Voter ID card/Aadhar card/Driving license/Passport/Pan card), caste certificate and two passport size recent colour photographs, with 2 sets of self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents.

The experience certificate must clearly mention the duration of experience, post held, nature of work, and the employer's signature with date; otherwise it will be treated as invalid. The District Level Selection Committee (DLSC) may ask for other documents, with prior notice.
important_instructions: Any omission or suppression of information will result in rejection of the application or cancellation of candidature at any stage without further intimation. If any information is found false, incorrect or misleading, or any document forged/fabricated, at any stage or during engagement, the candidature/engagement will be cancelled forthwith, without prejudice to other action under the applicable rules/law. Incomplete online applications are liable to result in cancellation of candidature. Failure to produce any requisite document at verification may result in cancellation of candidature. The District Health & Family Welfare Samiti reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason. Updates will be posted on the official website of the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal, and the concerned district website. The office email printed on the notice is [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About CMOH Purulia
content_sections.text: The Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health, Purulia functions under the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal, from the Zilla Swasthya Bhawan Campus, Ranchi Road, Purulia. The notice is signed by Dr. Asok Biswas, CMOH & Secretary, District Health and Family Welfare Samiti, Purulia. These posts are filled under the National Ayush Mission for the District AYUSH Samity, Purulia, and the posts cover the Ayurvidya programme, a Mobile Medical Unit for the tribal dominated population, Lymphatic Filariasis and the AYUSH office.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 8 posts with 1 vacancy each, all in the Unreserved (UR) category, for a total of 8 vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All applicants must be permanent residents of West Bengal and must possess adequate knowledge of the local language. The notice states that the prescribed conditions are non-relaxable. Each post's own conditions are below. Essential: Graduate from any recognized university and have completed at least 1 year Diploma Course in Computer (including MS Office – MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel) from a Govt. registered Institution. Desirable: Exposure in social sector schemes/Govt. Missions at National, State and District level. Age: Minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential: Graduate degree in Homeopathy (BHMS) from a recognized university. Desirable: Working experience in Public Health Programme of Government / PSUs or reputed private organization. Desirable: Exposure in social sector schemes/Govt. Missions at National, State and District level; computer knowledge including MS Office – MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel. Age: Minimum 21 years and maximum 50 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential criteria: Retired State Govt. Employees; Computer Literate Person. Desirable: Experience of working in the Health & FW Dept will be given preference (experience of working at clerical posts like LDC/accounts clerk etc.). Age: Maximum age limit 62 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential: Retired State Government Employees with experiences in the related field. Class X Pass. Computer Knowledge. Must be fit physically and mentally. Age: Maximum age limit 62 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential: Graduation in Computer Application/IT/Business Administration/B.Tech (C.S) or (I.T)/BCA/BBA/B.Sc-IT/Graduation with one year Diploma/Certificate course in Computer Application from a Government registered institute or university. Working knowledge of computer with operating knowledge of MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel, MS Access and Internet. Essential experience: Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience in a Government or any other reputed organization. Desirable: Typing speed of English – 30 WPM and Bengali – 25 WPM; exposure in social sector schemes at National, State and District level. Residence: Candidates shall be the permanent resident of the district concerned or within the same Revenue Division. Age: Minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years as on date 01.04.2026. Age relaxation for reserved categories shall be admissible as per the prevailing rules/orders of the Government of West Bengal, and only for candidates of the categories for which such relaxation is permissible under the prevailing Government rules. For the full eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for every post is a consolidated remuneration per month: Rs. 40,000/- for each Ayush Doctor, 25,000/- for the Data Entry Operator, Rs. 15,000/- for each Multipurpose Worker (MPW), Rs.12,000/- for the Accountant and Rs.10,000/- for the Lower Division Clerk. The LDC and Accountant posts, open only to retired State Government employees, carry the same fixed consolidated amount given in the table. The engagement is purely contractual and temporary in nature. Selected candidates may be posted at any health facility/institution/unit under the administrative control of the District AYUSH Samity/District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, as decided by the competent authority, and no claim for posting at a particular place shall be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection is conducted by the District Level Selection Committee, Purulia. The marking for each post is printed in the notice as follows. Data Entry Operator (AYUSH) marking: Class X – 10 marks (proportionate marking) Class XII – 10 marks (proportionate marking) Bachelor degree – 10 marks (proportionate marking) Post Graduation – 10 marks Experience – 10 marks: 2 marks for the essential experience plus 2 marks for each completed year of experience over and above the essential experience Computer Test – 50 marks Interview – 10 marks Being named in the list of candidates called for the Computer Test/Interview/Document Verification does not confer any right to appointment; candidature remains provisional until all original documents are verified and all eligibility conditions are met. No TA/DA is admissible for the Computer Test, Written Test, Interview, Document Verification or any other stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CMOH Purulia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies, one each for eight posts, all in the UR category, under the National Ayush Mission for the District AYUSH Samity, Purulia.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online applications are accepted until 19.11.2026, but the last date of online registration is 18.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Ayush Doctor post?
faq.answer: A Graduate degree in Homeopathy (BHMS) from a recognized university is essential; public health programme experience and social sector exposure are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: As on 01.04.2026, it is 21 to 40 years for MPW and Data Entry Operator, 21 to 50 years for Ayush Doctor, and a maximum of 62 years for LDC and Accountant, with relaxation as per West Bengal Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 40,000/- for Ayush Doctor, 25,000/- for Data Entry Operator, Rs. 15,000/- for MPW, Rs.12,000/- for Accountant and Rs.10,000/- for LDC.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for CMOH Purulia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only on www.wbhealth.gov.in under Quick links → Career, Education & Recruitment → Online Recruitment; no physical documents are to be sent to the office.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by the District Level Selection Committee, Purulia, on marks out of 100 for MPW, Ayush Doctor and Data Entry Operator (academic marks, experience and, where set, a computer test and interview), and by Interview – 10 for LDC and Accountant.

faq.question: Q8. Can retired employees apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The Lower Division Clerk (LDC) AYUSH and Accountant (AYUSH) posts are only for retired State Government employees, up to 62 years as on 01.04.2026, at a fixed consolidated Rs.10,000/- and Rs.12,000/- a month respectively.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, if you meet the eligibility of each post, but only one application is allowed per post; more than one application for the same post cancels all of them for that post.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice states the engagement is purely contractual and temporary in nature.
